about: Corrections to the rules text in lorcana-cards.raw.json, applied by packages/lorcana/bin/build_db.dart. Each entry replaces one card's text with the printed wording; 'why' says what the bulk data got wrong and where the wording was checked.

Falling Down The Rabbit Hole.text: Each player chooses one of their characters and puts them into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
Falling Down The Rabbit Hole.why: The bulk text says "facedown and excreted". Lorcast's text for the card (listed as "Falling Down the Rabbit Hole", so the name-matched fill misses it) and the printed card say "facedown and exerted".
